tasks.description: Builds a metadata catalog of mixed Markdown, HTML, CSV, JSON, text and log files with type, size, line count, title, author and date. Use when asked for a metadata catalog of a folder of mixed documents.
tasks.intent: Catalog file metadata for a folder of mixed documents.

tasks.description: Tags prose files with a likely language from common-word counts and flags low-confidence results. Use when asked for a language tag report on a folder of text documents.
tasks.intent: Tag prose documents with a likely language.

tasks.description: Extracts plain text from each sample file and indexes word counts with a short preview. Use when asked for an extracted-text index of a folder of mixed documents.
tasks.intent: Index the extracted plain text of mixed documents.
